in_hebrew.name: חרברת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Harbert is derived from the Hebrew word 'har' (mountain) and 'beret' (strength). It is often translated as 'mountain of strength' or 'strong mountain' in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Ἁρμος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Harbert in Greek is derived from the word 'harmos' which means 'strong'. It is a name of power and strength in ancient Greek texts.

in_latin.name: Harbertus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Harbert in Latin is derived from the Latin word 'harus' which means 'mountain' and 'beratus' which means 'free'. Thus, Harbertus means 'strong as a mountain, free man'.
